Mercedes-Maybach W222

Due to the nature of its 12-cylinder engine,
it has 12 coils and 24 plugs.
It's truly impressive.

Its structure makes it difficult to access preventive maintenance.
Why is it so difficult for just anyone to drive?
From a realistic maintenance cost perspective.

I hope this is helpful to imported car owners.
